cases.name: subtract-no-provider
cases.note: No boolean provider installed: a named capability error, not a fake uncut mesh, and both brushes untouched.

cases.name: hollow-too-thick
cases.note: The Reddit case: wall thickness 100 on a 128-cube leaves no inner solid. The hollow must refuse with hollow-too-thick and the 128-cube must survive with its full volume — never delete the brush it was asked to hollow.

cases.name: hollow-thickness-zero
cases.note: Zero wall thickness is not a hollow: named refusal, source brush untouched.

cases.name: merge-not-convex
cases.note: Two 2-cubes offset 1 on X and Y union into an L-shape, which is not convex: the merge is refused and both 2-cubes survive.

cases.name: intersect-disjoint
cases.note: Tool 10 units away on X: no shared volume, named empty result, both brushes untouched.

cases.name: intersect-no-provider
cases.note: No boolean provider installed: a named capability error, not a fake mesh, and both brushes untouched.

note: Failure-safety cases for hammer-csg-failure-safety (board hammer-csg-failure-safety). Every case MUST fail with its expectedReason, return no mesh, and leave its inputs byte-identical to snapshots taken before the call. All boxes are axis-aligned and centred on the origin unless toolOffset moves the tool; volumes are in Geppetto Desktop kernel units (inches, Z-up). The mapcsg group (tests/MapCsgTests.cs) recomputes the subtract/merge/hollow cases; the mapcsgintersect group (tests/MapCsgIntersectTests.cs) recomputes the intersect cases. Cases with "provider": "none" run with MeshBoolean.Provider set to null.
